result.question: What happens to the unbelieving captain?

readings.answer: He will see it but not eat any of it.
readings.support: You will see it with your own eyes | but you will not eat any of it.

assessments.reason: Elisha tells the doubting officer, “You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of it,” which matches the key’s point that he will not eat the flour or barley.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says the officer will see the event but not eat any of it, aligning with the key that he won’t eat the flour or barley.
